title: Ohm's Law Circuit
guideExplore: Close the switch and change V or R — watch current and bulb brightness follow I = V/R.
guideHighVoltage: High voltage pushes more current through the same resistance — the bulb glows brighter.
guideHighResistance: High resistance limits current — even with voltage, the bulb stays dim.
guideOpenCircuit: An open switch breaks the path — current drops to zero and the bulb goes dark.
conditionsHint: Ohm's law: current I equals voltage V divided by resistance R (I = V/R).
learnMore: Closing the switch completes the loop. Raising V increases I; raising R decreases I. Bulb brightness tracks current.
